# Source / Verification Notes

## Original inspiration

YouTube Short supplied by Zee:

https://youtube.com/shorts/LpRHxiUFiiY?is=lEYKqjR9ymEcHfi5

The identifying concept supplied in chat was **touch hologram**.

## Verified open-source match saved here

Repository: https://github.com/y2xs/Hologram

Why it matches the concept:

- webcam/camera-based hand tracking
- real-time manipulation of a holographic particle object
- rotation driven by hand position
- zoom/expansion driven by thumb-to-index distance
- black/high-contrast rendering suitable for hologram-style reflective display setups
- MIT license permits reuse with attribution

## Scope note

This folder should be treated as a **verified implementation of the same interaction concept**, not a claim that `y2xs/Hologram` is the creator/source repository of the YouTube Short. The Short's public metadata/source repository could not be independently tied to that GitHub project during this import.

## Related true-haptic direction

If the goal is a hologram that can actually be *felt* in mid-air rather than controlled by gestures, the next research layer is ultrasonic haptics / focused ultrasound plus hand tracking. Keep that as a separate hardware phase so the current browser demo remains simple and testable.
